About the Role:

We are looking for an AI Engineer with 10+ years in infrastructure roles (network, security or systems engineering) with at least 3 years focused on automation or platform development.

Responsibilities:

Expert level Python; production experience with Ansible (including Tower/AWX) and terraform.
Proven track record building automation that delivered measurable outcomes, such as reduced manual effort, faster incident resolution, or improved audit adherence.
Deep familiarity with at least two infrastructure domains among: enterprise networking, firewall and security operations, systems engineering, and cloud networking.
Hands on experience with REST API orchestration across multi vendor infrastructure platforms.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code practices in production environments.
Working knowledge of security and compliance frameworks (NIST, CIS, ISO 27001) and Zero Trust principles.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience building or deploying AI/LLM powered tools, including RAG pipelines, AI assistants, or agentic automation for operations teams.
Full stack development capability (Rust, Go, TypeScript, or similar) with experience shipping internal platforms adopted by other teams.
Experience with ITSM platforms (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management) and automating ticket workflows for Helpdesk and NOC.
Kubernetes, service mesh (Istio), and WAF deployment experience.
Experience supporting 24/7 operations, on call rotations, and global multi-site environments.
Background in MA infrastructure integrations or large-scale refresh projects.
Relevant certifications such as PCNSE, CCNP, CISSP, or cloud provider certifications.

#LI-Onsite #LI-SS1
